sections.text: ETV6::RET has been confirmed by molecular analysis in salivary secretory carcinoma. It is an alternative to the more common ETV6::NTRK3-associated form.

sections.text: For RET-fusion-positive locally advanced or metastatic solid tumors, selpercatinib is US-approved from age 2 years after prior systemic treatment or when no satisfactory alternative exists; this is a RET biomarker-class indication.

report_comment.text: ETV6 encodes an ETS-family transcriptional repressor with an amino-terminal oligomerization domain. RET encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase activated by GDNF-family ligands and their coreceptors. ETV6::RET has been confirmed by molecular analysis in salivary secretory carcinoma. It is an alternative to the more common ETV6::NTRK3-associated form. For RET-fusion-positive locally advanced or metastatic solid tumors, selpercatinib is US-approved from age 2 years after prior systemic treatment or when no satisfactory alternative exists; this is a RET biomarker-class indication.
